scope: Integer landmark estimates in native.png input coordinates for a later explicit geometric resampling step. Neither original 3D recovery nor an artistic/projection acceptance.

coordinate_convention.points: integer texel-center indices; (0,0) is first texel center
coordinate_convention.upstream_mapping: Original generated source correspondence remains in each receipt refined_grid.x_source_centers/y_source_centers.

method: Images visually inspected at native size, with alpha-support convex hull and local color-edge samples as aids. Corner coordinates are estimates of drawn outline center, not guaranteed metric vertices. Inferred/occluded points explicitly identified.
limits: Native grids are nonuniformly refined upstream; a square original may yield unequal native width/height.
The later common-PPU 127 mapping changes sample placement and is geometric resampling, separate from PerfectPixel normalization.
Low-alpha fringe samples are not removed from the original; measuring strong-alpha support does not authorize clipping them.
Circular base projected-center and lowest visible contact pixel are different anchors.

assets.observation: Seven visible box corners; no missing back-lower corner manufactured.
assets.geometry_warning: Measured top-back differs about 1px from the other three-corner parallelogram. Do not report exact original isometry.

assets.observation: Lid ellipse rim is approximately x54..152, y18..72; frontmost bottom rim is y195. Inferred circle center uses same approximate 27px ellipse semi-height and is hidden by front staves.

assets.observation: Visible leaves overlap the pot rim; foliage box encloses visually identified leaf pixels/outline and is not a segmentation mask. Last strong-alpha pot row y174 spans x84..95.
assets.geometry_warning: Irregular foliage has no reliable planar homography or cuboid corners. A leaf bounding box is only an extent.

base_top_back.method: top_left + top_right - top_front in image coordinates; hidden by register mechanism

assets.observation: Drawer body occupies the lower volume; sloped keypad, rear cylinder and receipt rise beyond it. Seven body corners cannot all be directly measured because the back-top point is occluded.
assets.geometry_warning: Do not treat the complete register as only the cash-drawer box or distort the upper mechanism into its top plane. Preserve full upper silhouette with an explicit separate domain/physical height.
